inventory.interpretation: The 186 aggregate observer frames are not 186 unique opaque class records. The source capture map contains 74 opaque carriers plus 112 standard-object frames. Bounded physical AC1021 routes now qualify 65 opaque carriers: 25 VISUALSTYLE, 17 SCALE, 12 DICTIONARYVAR, three MATERIAL, one DBCOLOR, one ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT, one ACDBPLACEHOLDER, two ACDBSECTIONVIEWSTYLE, two ACDBDETAILVIEWSTYLE, and one MLEADERSTYLE. They qualify 74 standard-object frames, including the selected VisualStyle, MATERIAL and DBCOLOR dependencies plus the two ModelDocViewStyle root dictionaries, four extension dictionaries, four XRECORDs, and the MLEADERSTYLE owner dictionary. These are selected graph routes with ASCII/Binary output and readback; MATERIAL, DBCOLOR, ModelDocViewStyle and DICTIONARYWDFLT/PLACEHOLDER also check their applicable retained payloads and transaction refusal/retry. The remaining nine opaque carriers and 38 standard-object frames remain unqualified; source-byte capture or matching typed callbacks alone do not qualify serialization.
